What is read, and what never leaves your phone
Removes your workouts, crew membership and files

CrewFit shows how many steps you have taken today, and gives you bonus points in the crew ranking on every day you reach 10,000.

The steps are read from Health Connect, where your phone and any watch or fitness app record them. CrewFit only reads them - it never writes health data, and it reads nothing beyond the step count.

Your daily total is stored on the CrewFit server, and the members of your crew see how far you are towards the daily goal. That is the point of it: the crew pushes each other. Only the number of steps per day leaves your device - no times, no routes, no other health data.

You can withdraw the access at any time in the Health Connect settings. CrewFit then stops reading and stops updating your number.
